st_soupirs.name: Rue des Inquiets
st_soupirs.alt: A long green lawn walk lined with flowering rose hedges and sandy paths; a little garden pavilion with a plum-purple door under a lantern, a teal arched door in the garden wall and an iron gate under an arch of roses. Monsieur Verbe worries under his own little raincloud, chewing his glove, mirror in hand; frowns at his plain soup in a gold beret, mirror in hand; holds up an envelope and points at himself; crashes his cymbals and startles the napping cat; kneels to pat a trembling puppy; and shouts so loudly the birds fly off the hedge. The sandy path on the left leads back to the Quartier de la Santé.

doors.label: Rue du Sourire
doors.hint: Through the iron garden gate under the roses

rires.name: Allée des Rires-et-Larmes
rires.alt: A sunny corner of the rose garden with an old stone wishing well; the plum-purple door of the garden pavilion on the left. Monsieur Verbe weeps peeling an onion; tells a joke to a pheasant; holds his heart, sorry, beside a knocked-over flower pot; laughs helplessly in a gold beret as a feather tickles him; finds only a sock in his magic hat in a gold beret; and tosses a coin into the wishing well, hoping.

applaudissements.name: Place des Applaudissements
applaudissements.alt: A sunny lawn among the rose hedges with a white bandstand hung with bunting and an old television on a high shelf; a teal arched door in the garden wall on the left. Monsieur Verbe raises his hand with the other on a big book, making a solemn promise; wobbles along a low rope; holds his heart as little hearts float up in a gold beret; reaches for the television, out of reach on its high shelf; claps loudly in a green beret; and holds his full tummy beside an empty cake plate.

doors.label: Rue des Inquiets
doors.hint: Back through the teal arched door

sourire.name: Rue du Sourire
sourire.alt: A sunny rose garden with sunflowers and a round stone fountain with a wooden plank across it; an iron gate under an arch of roses on the left. Monsieur Verbe smiles from ear to ear by the sunflowers in a gold beret; sips his tea with eyes closed at a little table; kicks at a ball and misses; opens a gift with delight in a gold beret; hesitates on the plank over the fountain; and pokes out his tongue at a pigeon, mirror in hand.

doors.label: Rue des Inquiets
doors.hint: Back through the iron garden gate
